desc: 灯下绒面暖袋套图，热度时长与功率一律只留空位
leaf: 绒套式密封电热暖手袋
name: 燕麦灯下绒套电热暖手袋款

shots.intent: 用一盏灯把软袋的取暖属性一眼讲清，以夜间暖场加主张文案拿下详情页第一眼停留。
shots.textZone: upper band: one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in bouclé #E0D3C1 at 34pt, one dashed running-stitch rule in #E4A32C under it, one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」 at 14pt

shots.intent: 用五张去身份的缝线色卡放大冬日发冷的真实瞬间，全程不露脸、不做任何体感数值暗示。
shots.textZone: left column: one headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in copy ink #3A2E28 at 30pt plus one short line on the eyelet tag reading 「{callout_2}」 at 12pt

shots.intent: 把绒边与印面交界的一圈走线推到眼前，用可实拍的缝制工艺替代一切材质与功效宣称。
把软袋放进夜间阅读角完成代入，人物只留下颌以下且双手不触碰发热面。
用同机位双栏交代外罩与内袋两层可见构造，比较只停在形制层面，不给任何结果结论。
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_3}」 under the left panel and one 「{callout_4}」 under the right in copy ink #3A2E28 at 14pt, one headline 「{selling_point_3}」 above the split at 28pt

shots.intent: 从俯角讲清外罩开口与扣合边的做法，把可拆洗结构与操作方式画在可见处，不写任何参数。
用图鉴式平铺与一整列空白参数行承接规格疑问，所有数值与资质栏位一律留空。
shots.textZone: right column: section headline 「{selling_point_4}」 in copy ink #3A2E28 at 28pt above six blank dashed rows, each row carrying only a field label placeholder reading 「{callout_5}」 at 12pt with its value left empty

shots.intent: 把可选外罩一次并排摊开，让买家在同一盏灯下完成颜色决策，不写任何套数与价格。
shots.textZone: one short colourway label 「{callout_6}」 under each unit in copy ink #3A2E28 at 12pt

shots.intent: 用完全可实拍的周边走线、扣合边与眼孔吊牌收口去风险，不借任何资质与检测背书。
shots.textZone: lower band: one short closing line 「{callout_7}」 in bouclé #E0D3C1 at 20pt with one dashed running-stitch rule in #E4A32C above it

shots.intent: 回扣首屏的灯下暖场，用一句短主张与一枚缝线按钮形卡片把心动转成下单动作。
shots.textZone: upper band: one close line 「{selling_point_5}」 in bouclé #E0D3C1 at 30pt and one button-shaped stitched tag carrying short rendered copy 「{callout_8}」 in accent thread #E4A32C

style.backgroundSystem: only two fields alternate across the set: a frost room wall #E9EEF1 standing over a bouclé swatch platform #E0D3C1 for the pain-point, comparison, spec and colourway screens, and a deep ink night field #2B211C carrying one soft lamp pool for the promise, scene and closing screens; a matte plaster ledge #C9B9A2 is the one shared plane joining them, and a folded bouclé swatch stack is the only recurring prop; no scenery, no window views, no seasonal decoration
style.direction: hearth-lit textile still-life commerce for a soft electric warmer
style.iconSystem: single-weight dashed running-stitch pictograms in accent thread #E4A32C held inside square stitched frames with one punched eyelet at the upper corner; only textile pictograms are allowed, namely a folded swatch, a stitched seam line, an eyelet tag, a pile loop and a thread loop; no filled badges, no circles, no hexagons, no shields, no medals, no plugs, no USB marks, no thermometers, no flames, no sound-wave arcs, no medical or protective marks
style.lightingSystem: a single warm 3000K lamplight key always entering from frame upper right, backed by a much weaker cool bounce from frame left so the warmth reads as one lamp inside a cold room; soft wrapped shadows with one fine raking band travelling across the pile, never a hard specular, never a flat top light, never a front flash, no second colour temperature anywhere in the set, and the key direction never flips between screens
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent hearth-lit textile still-life system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost room wall #E9EEF1, deep ink night field #2B211C, bouclé swatch platform #E0D3C1, matte plaster ledge #C9B9A2, copy ink #3A2E28 and one accent thread #E4A32C; a single warm 3000K lamplight key entering from frame upper right with a much weaker cool bounce from frame left, soft wrapped shadows and one fine raking band across the pile, never a hard specular, never a flat top light, no second colour temperature anywhere; rounded humanist sans-serif only, copy in #3A2E28 on the frost field and #E0D3C1 on the ink field, one dashed running-stitch rule in #E4A32C under each headline; single-weight dashed running-stitch pictograms in #E4A32C inside square stitched frames with one punched eyelet, textile pictograms only; fields alternate between the frost wall over a bouclé platform and the ink night field carrying one lamp pool, joined by a plaster ledge #C9B9A2; the same plump rectangular soft pouch at the same proportion, printed face square to camera, cover opening facing frame left, never floating, never clipped; every claim value stays a placeholder, so no temperature, no degrees mark, no heating duration, no timer, no battery or capacity figure, no auto-off or standard wording, no medical or therapeutic heat wording, no material grade or fibre content, no certificate or test mark, no wattage or noise or lifespan claim, no percentages or digits, no brand wordmark or mascot artwork absent from the reference, no face, no price, no QR code, no membership badge, no sleeping or in-bed use, no bare skin on the heating face, no hand on any connector, no poured water and no open or dripping fill neck; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #E9EEF1, #2B211C, #E0D3C1, #C9B9A2, #3A2E28 and #E4A32C
no thermal-burn proof marks anywhere: no temperature value, no degrees mark, no hot-cold gauge, no heating duration, no countdown, no timer numeral and no auto-off or safety-standard wording
no electrical figures: no wattage, voltage, current, battery capacity, runtime, noise level, rotation speed or lifespan claim, and no protection-rating or plug-standard marks

no therapeutic or authority wording: no medical-grade phrasing, no heat-therapy or treatment claims, no doctor, hospital or laboratory endorsement, no certificate, seal, award, inspection report, registration number or standard code
no material declaration: no fibre content, no fabric weight, no yarn count, no PVC or rubber grade naming, no origin or imported-material claim, no antibacterial or hypoallergenic statement

never depict unsafe use: no sleeping, dozing or in-bed pose with the unit, no blanket covering it, no bare skin pressed onto the heating face, no hand touching any connector or contact plate, no liquid being poured and no open, wet or dripping fill neck or stopper; if the reference shows a fill neck or collar it is drawn closed with its stopper seated
no numeric proof of any kind: no percentages, no comparison curves, no ratings, no sales counts, no piece counts, no dimensions and no spec digits printed in-image

no de-identification failures: no brand wordmark, shop name, mascot or character artwork absent from the reference image, no watermark, no QR code, no membership or promotional badge, no price, coupon or shipping promise
no person is identifiable: every figure is cropped below the chin or from the shoulders down, anonymous, with hands never resting on the product
no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no second colour temperature, no mismatched icon styles between screens
style.presentationRules: the same plump rectangular soft pouch at the same proportion in every screen: laid on its broad face or stood upright on its own base with the printed face square to camera, the stitched perimeter seam level and the corner radius unchanged, the cover opening always facing frame left; grouped units keep identical spacing, identical pile direction and identical lamp output; the unit never floats and never loses its contact shadow, and nothing is clipped by the frame edge
style.surfaceSystem: bouclé swatch platform #E0D3C1 with real looped pile and a stitched edge, laid over a matte plaster ledge #C9B9A2 with a fine powdery grain; textile is rendered as textile with individual loops, and never as marble, never as mirror plate, never as polished acrylic, never as smooth plastic sheet
style.typography: rounded humanist sans-serif only; copy set in ink #3A2E28 on the frost field and in bouclé #E0D3C1 on the ink field, one dashed running-stitch rule in accent thread #E4A32C under every headline instead of a solid rule; short labels only, generous leading, and every rendered word supplied as a placeholder token with no digit ever printed
